design_philosophy: A functional, high-visibility 'Control Room' dashboard for emergency routing in Acapulco. Built on the Swiss Brutalist archetype but injected with hyper-saturated neon accents (Acid Yellow, Vivid Cyan, Signal Red) over a dark canvas to meet the 'colores llamativos' requirement. Prioritizes radical clarity, utilizing 'Crystal Glassmorphism' to float data panels above the interactive map without losing geospatial context.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-white leading-none
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-white leading-tight

structure: Base: Absolute full-screen Leaflet map layer (z-0).
UI Layer: Floating panel (z-10) positioned top-left on desktop (w-96, h-auto max-h-[90vh]), and a bottom sheet on mobile (w-full).
Grid inside panel: Dense bento grid (grid-cols-2) for metrics. Span 1 for single metrics (time, distance), span 2 for main actions.
layout.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) for glass panels. gap-6 between form sections.

components.surface_style: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-zinc-950/70 border border-white/15 rounded-xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
components.button_primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#DFFF33] hover:text-black transition-all border border-transparent hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)]

shadcn_overrides.Select: Customize Shadcn Select to have bg-black/50, border-white/20, text-white. Hover/Focus: border-[#CCFF00]
shadcn_overrides.Card: Strip default Vercel look. Apply the Crystal Glassmorphism surface_style. Ensure p-6 padding inside.

map_styling.tile_layer: Use CartoDB Dark Matter (https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png) for high contrast.
map_styling.start_marker: Color: #00E5FF, Circle marker with 8px radius, bordered white.
map_styling.school_marker: Color: #FF0055, Circle marker with 8px radius, bordered white.

motion.hover: Interactive elements scale slightly (scale-105) or translate-y (-translate-y-1).
motion.panel_entrance: Slide-in: { x: -50, opacity: 0 } to { x: 0, opacity: 1 } on desktop.

icons.usage: Use bold or duotone variants for high visibility on dark backgrounds.

images.usage: Use as a subtle intro background for loading screens or 'About' modals, heavily overlaid with bg-zinc-950/80 to maintain text contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: react-leaflet, leaflet, @phosphor-icons/react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main structural wrappers to allow floating map overlays.
For the UI Panel, implement 'Crystal Glass' aesthetic. Do NOT use standard opaque Shadcn cards.

Typography MUST follow the JSON rules. Import fonts via Google Fonts (Clash Display via Fontshare if needed, or fallback to Outfit if Clash is unavailable, but IBM Plex Sans & JetBrains Mono are mandatory).
Ensure map occupies the entire viewport (`h-screen w-screen`). The controls should float above it (absolute top-6 left-6).
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (Select, Button, Route Results) using kebab-case role-based names.
Enforce APCA contrast standards. Neon text on dark backgrounds is highly accessible, but ensure thin weights aren't lost. Use font-medium or font-semibold for neon text.
